visual_segment_estimate.meaning: Human estimate including weak changes and in-shot micro-beats; not a hard-cut count.

phase_map.name: archive_setup
phase_map.observed: Top-down archive table enters from darkness.
phase_map.rule: Establish the research world before explaining the subject.

phase_map.name: archive_question
phase_map.observed: Folders, tabs, cards, diagrams and tools form rapid graphic matches.
phase_map.rule: Use paper, labels and repeated shapes as editorial grammar.

phase_map.name: light_table_operation
phase_map.observed: Hands activate and rearrange the flat research space.
phase_map.rule: Use one deliberate physical action per beat.

phase_map.name: physical_experiment
phase_map.observed: Tools, field drawings, powder, metal sphere, scale and monochrome material inserts alternate.
phase_map.rule: Make an abstract idea behave like a measurable physical force.

phase_map.name: geometric_reference
phase_map.observed: Numbers, architecture, spherical imagery, compass work and field diagrams connect through circles.
phase_map.rule: Carry one geometric motif across unlike materials.

phase_map.name: tactile_material_peak
phase_map.observed: Deep blue book, embossed pages and powder macro move toward field-line textures.
phase_map.rule: Let tactile material become the precursor of the final abstraction.

phase_map.name: symbol_lockup
phase_map.observed: Field lines stabilize, fade, pass through small typographic variants and settle into a centered wordmark.
phase_map.rule: Reduce complexity to a new symbol without copying the source glyph transformation.

sound.reference_pulse_interpretation: approximately 80 BPM half-time or 160 BPM subdivision

originality_constraints: Do not reuse the source brand, logo, wordmark or readable copy.
Do not reproduce the source prop combination or shot order.
Rebuild the core metaphor, hero material and graphic chain around the new subject.
Preserve complex-to-simple structure without reproducing the source glyph morph.
Mark unreadable text and uncertain object meaning as uncertain rather than inventing facts.
